title: File:Snowmelt Stream near Bridalveil Falls (5637226088).jpg
author: InSapphoWeTrust from Los Angeles, California, USA
description:
With the snow melting, and with the snow pack in the Sierra Nevada at 176% of normal, the streams are flowing rather ferociously throughout Yosemite.

Using a photography class favorite trick (longer exposure - 1/6th of a second), I got this shot that emphasizes the flow of water down the stream.
